🛡️ Remediation Recommendations

1. Exported Components

Set android:exported="false" on all components. Use android:protectionLevel="signature" for inter-app communication. Audit all intent filters.

2. Weak Cryptography

Replace AES/ECB with AES/GCM/NoPadding. Use SHA-256 or bcrypt for password hashing. Store keys in AndroidKeyStore.

3. Insecure Data Storage

Use EncryptedSharedPreferences. Encrypt databases with SQLCipher. Never store passwords/tokens in plaintext.

4. Network Security

Implement SSL pinning via network_security_config.xml. Set android:usesCleartextTraffic="false".

5. Logging

Remove Log.d()/Log.v() in production via ProGuard stripping. Never log credentials or PII.
